v2_findings.title: Professional Liability — Ransomware / Extortion Exclusion
v2_findings.content:
[Ugly] Professional Liability — Ransomware / Extortion Exclusion
Risk Score: 16/25

What this means:
Ransomware is the #1 cyber threat to election infrastructure right now. Your professional liability policy excludes it entirely. Your cyber policy covers it up to $4 million — but that same $4 million also has to cover business interruption, data restoration, breach notification, lawsuits, and regul

Recommendation:
Increase Cyber aggregate to $10M minimum, with separate ransomware sublimit at $5M+. Implement and document offline backups, segmented networks, and incident response retainer for underwriter credit.

What this means:
If your insurance company recommends settling a lawsuit and you say no — for very legitimate reputational reasons — your share of any larger judgment goes from 0% to 50%. Recommendation:
At renewal, push to consolidate to a single 80/20 hammer or eliminate the SIR/deductible distinction. Document a settlement-decision protocol involving CFO, GC, and CEO with insurance broker advisory.

v2_findings.title: Professional Liability — Biometric Identifiers Exclusion (BI
v2_findings.content:
[Ugly] Professional Liability — Biometric Identifiers Exclusion (BI
Risk Score: 15/25

What this means:
Illinois has a law called BIPA. If you use voter signature matching or any biometric verification (face, fingerprint, voice) on Illinois voters, and your privacy disclosures aren't perfectly compliant, every single voter record is worth $1,000-$5,000 in statutory damages in a class action. Recommendation:
Confirm whether biometric processing occurs and in which states. If yes, place standalone biometric/privacy liability cover (specialty market). Ensure consent forms and retention policies meet BIPA/CC

body: Policy covers IT services but then carves back most technology failures.
If election hardware malfunctions or delays ballot processing, there is no coverage.

presentation_slides.title: Insufficient Cancellation Notice
body: We expect a 90-day notice of cancellation or nonrenewal from our carrier partners.
This gives us sufficient time to perform a thorough marketing effort for replacement coverage.

presentation_slides.title: Multiple Policies
body: Additional Named Insureds Completely or Partially Missing from most policies.

presentation_slides.title: E&O Policy
body: Additional Insureds covered for defense only, no indemnity.
All contracts require Runbeck to Defend, Indemnify and Hold Harmless, not just defend.

presentation_slides.title: E&O Policy
body: E&O Exclusion against recalls / reprinting. Your cost to do so will not be covered.
